name: new-tab
description: A rounded window with a centered plus for opening a new tab in a square frame.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Window centerline bounds 7..17 on both axes with corner radius 2.25. The plus uses centered half-extent 1.75 at Regular 1.75. Natural Filled uses the matching window exterior bounds 6.125..17.875 / radius 3.125 and the exact Regular plus as a transparent counter. No top divider crowds the small native drawing. Even at Bold, the plus and inner window border remain separated by .75px. The rounded window retains more than .48px Circle clearance at Bold. All None/Square/Circle forms use the identical native glyph position and size, without per-frame transforms. Outline defaults to Regular 1.75 with round caps/joins, Thin 1.25 and Bold 2.50. Standard frame exteriors span 2..22, with Square radius 4 and Circle radius 10; Outline frame centerlines span 2.875..21.125 with corner radius 3.125 / Circle radius 9.125. Framed Filled subtracts the exact standalone Filled silhouette as transparent negative space. Original project geometry; no third-party SVG paths used. All forms remain drafts pending owner review.

review.note: New window action icon and frame variants; awaits owner review.
